decisions.reason: No additional change is needed because the existing same-message MODIFY already updates the FAQ's referral and NFT-transfer messaging to exclude old-contract NFTs from active systems.
No additional change is needed because the existing same-message MODIFY already restarts displayed mint statistics at #1 for the new active contract and excludes old-contract copies.
No additional change is needed because the existing same-message MODIFY fully limits referral-code identity and numbering to NFTs minted by the new active contract.
No additional change is needed because the existing same-message MODIFY already restricts random no-code reward recipients to holders in the new active contract.
No additional change is needed because the existing same-message MODIFY already excludes old-contract NFT copies from dashboard and project-system visibility.
No additional change is needed because the existing same-message MODIFY already scopes referral-reward and ticket accounting to the new active contract.
No additional change is needed because the existing same-message MODIFY already excludes old-contract NFT activity from public referral statistics.
No additional change is needed because the existing same-message MODIFY already restarts ticket and draw accounting under the new active contract and excludes old-contract tickets.
No additional change is needed because the existing same-message MODIFY already limits active draw participation to new-contract NFTs and records that draws restart under that contract.
No additional change is needed because the existing same-message MODIFY already restricts Small Block eligibility to new-contract tickets and restarts draws under the new contract.
No additional change is needed because the existing same-message MODIFY already makes only token numbers minted in the new active contract valid referral codes.
The contract migration changes mint fulfillment ownership but does not change the USDC approval, payment, or connected-wallet mint-flow behavior represented by this Requirement.
